name: Maria Madrugada
overview: This is the story of Mary, a, beautiful and intelligent young woman. Her naiveté and drive to improve, will lead her to difficult situations she overcomes because of her cleverness. Mary does not trust men and is afraid of falling in love. Mateo is the father of two girls at the school where Mary teaches. He is a good husband and exceptional father and he never imagined his life would take such a dramatic turn.
